name.text: Determining general fertility and total fertility rate

questiontext.text:
From the figures given below calculate the general fertility rate and the total fertility rate.

Age Group No. of women Age specific fertility rate (per 1000)
\({@age_group1@}-{@age_group2@}\) \({@no_women1@}\) \({@fertility_rate1@}\)
\({@age_group2@}-{@age_group3@}\) \({@no_women2@}\) \({@fertility_rate2@}\)
\({@age_group3@}-{@age_group4@}\) \({@no_women3@}\) \({@fertility_rate3@}\)
\({@age_group4@}-{@age_group5@}\) \({@no_women4@}\) \({@fertility_rate4@}\)
\({@age_group5@}-{@age_group6@}\) \({@no_women5@}\) \({@fertility_rate5@}\)
\({@age_group6@}-{@age_group7@}\) \({@no_women6@}\) \({@fertility_rate6@}\)
\({@age_group7@}-{@age_group8@}\) \({@no_women7@}\) \({@fertility_rate7@}\)


(Note: Leave your answers upto \(2\) dp where necessary)

Find,

a). General fertility rate \(\textbf{(GRR)}= \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

b). Total fertility Rate \(\textbf{(TFR)}= \sum ASFR \times i \) where \(\text{ASFR}\) stands for Age-Specific Fertility Rate and \(i\) is the number of years in each age bracket.

\(\textbf{TFR}= \) [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]][[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

Age Group No. of women Age specific fertility rate (per 1000) Number of children born
\({@age_group1@}-{@age_group2@}\) \({@no_women1@}\) \({@fertility_rate1@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{{@no_women1@}\times {@fertility_rate1@}}{1000}={@decimalplaces(no_kids_born1,1)@}\)
\({@age_group2@}-{@age_group3@}\) \({@no_women2@}\) \({@fertility_rate2@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{{@no_women2@}\times {@fertility_rate2@}}{1000}={@decimalplaces(no_kids_born2,1)@}\)
\({@age_group3@}-{@age_group4@}\) \({@no_women3@}\) \({@fertility_rate3@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{{@no_women3@}\times {@fertility_rate3@}}{1000}={@decimalplaces(no_kids_born3,1)@}\)
\({@age_group4@}-{@age_group5@}\) \({@no_women4@}\) \({@fertility_rate4@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{{@no_women4@}\times {@fertility_rate4@}}{1000}={@decimalplaces(no_kids_born4,1)@}\)
\({@age_group5@}-{@age_group6@}\) \({@no_women5@}\) \({@fertility_rate5@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{{@no_women5@}\times {@fertility_rate5@}}{1000}={@decimalplaces(no_kids_born5,1)@}\)
\({@age_group6@}-{@age_group7@}\) \({@no_women6@}\) \({@fertility_rate6@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{{@no_women6@}\times {@fertility_rate6@}}{1000}={@decimalplaces(no_kids_born6,1)@}\)
\({@age_group7@}-{@age_group8@}\) \({@no_women7@}\) \({@fertility_rate7@}\) \(\displaystyle \frac{{@no_women7@}\times {@fertility_rate7@}}{1000}={@decimalplaces(no_kids_born7,1)@}\)
\(\sum\) total number of women \(={@sum_women@}\) total births per 1000 \(={@sum_fertility@}\) sum of children \(={@sum_kids@}\)


a). General fertility rate

\(\textbf{GRR}= \displaystyle \frac{ \text{total number of children born}}{\text{total number of women}} \times 1000=\displaystyle \frac {{@decimalplaces(sum_kids,1)@}}{{@sum_women@}} \times 1000={@grr@}\)


b). Total fertility Rate \(\textbf{TFR}= \sum ASFR \times i \) where \(\text{ASFR}\) stands for Age-Specific Fertility Rate and \(i\) is the number of years in each age bracket.

\(\textbf{TFR}={@sum_fertility@} \times {@age@}={@total_fertilityrate@} \)
